v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Oránte sancta Lúcia, * appáruit ei beáta Agatha, et consolabátur ancíllam Christi.
text.en: While St. Lucy was praying, * the blessed Agatha appeared unto her, and consoled the handmaiden of Christ.

text.la: Lúcia virgo, * quid a me petis quod ipsa póteris præstáre contínuo matri tuæ?
text.en: O virgin Lucy, * wherefore askest thou of me what thou canst thyself forthwith obtain for thy mother?

text.la: Per te, Lúcia virgo, * cívitas Syracusána decorábitur a Dómino Iesu Christo.
text.en: Through thee, O virgin Lucy, * the city of Syracuse shall be made glorious by the Lord Jesus Christ.

text.la: Benedíco te, * Pater Dómini mei Iesu Christi, quia per Fílium tuum ignis exstínctus est a látere meo.
text.en: I bless thee, * O Father of my Lord Jesus Christ, for through thy Son the fire was extinguished round about me.

text.la: Soror mea, Lúcia, * virgo Deo devóta, quid a me petis, quod ipsa póteris præstáre contínuo matri tuæ?
text.en: Lucy, my sister, * thou virgin consecrated to God, wherefore askest thou of me what thou canst thyself forthwith obtain for thy mother?

text.la: Fratres: Qui gloriátur, in Dómino gloriétur. Non enim qui seípsum comméndat, ille probátus est; sed quem Deus comméndat.
text.en: Brothers: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord. For not he who commendeth himself, is approved, but he, whom God commendeth.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Colúmna es * immóbilis, Lúcia, sponsa Christi: quia omnis plebs te exspéctat, ut accípias corónam vitæ, allelúia.
text.en: Thou art become as a pillar * that cannot be shaken, Lucy, O Bride of Christ: all the people wait for thee, until thou receive the crown of life, alleluia.

text.la: Exáudi nos, Deus, salutáris noster: ut sicut de beátæ Lúciæ Vírginis et Mártyris tuæ festivitáte gaudémus; ita piæ devotiónis erudiámur afféctu.
text.en: Graciously hear us, O God of our salvation; that as we rejoice in the festivity of blessed Lucy, thy Virgin and Martyr, we may be instructed in the affections of a loving devotion.

title.la: Feria IV infra Hebdomadam II Adventus
title.en: Feria IV infra Hebdomadam II Adventus

text.la: Ecce ego mitto Angelum meum, qui præparábit viam meam ante fáciem tuam.
text.en: Behold I send My angel which shall prepare My way before thy face.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Excita, Dómine, corda nostra ad præparándas Unigéniti tui vias: ut, per eius advéntum, purificátis tibi méntibus servíre mereámur:
text.en: Stir up our hearts, O Lord, to make ready the ways of thine Only-begotten Son, that by His coming our minds being purified, we may the more worthily give up ourselves to thy service: Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
